answer: Because the rationale is hashed into the signal record and indexed in the nadir history, the lantern audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Filling 185 aliases as a result needs 185 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 4 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
